Class Abilities

1st Level

Decipher Script (Intelligence)

  • Effect: Decipher unfamiliar writing, incomplete or archaic text, or coded messages — 10 minutes per page.
  • Identify an arcane scroll or spell by reading it (10 minutes); it then counts as identified (see Spellbooks & Scrolls in Spellcasting in Arneyan). A spell above the highest level you can cast needs a casting-stat check (see Spellbooks & Scrolls in Spellcasting in Arneyan), DC 10 + the spell's level
  • Cannot decipher divine scrolls. You can write scrolls of spells you know (see Downtime: Scribing, Scrolls & Potions)

Performance (Charisma)

  • Effect: Song, oration, battle cry or demeanour. Uses per day equal to your Bard level + your Charisma modifier (minimum 2). Spend a use as part of your action, once per round, so you can still cast or attack. Your Performance options:
  • Exalt (the default): one ally within 60ft who can see and hear you has Advantage on attribute checks and saves, including class ability checks but not attack rolls, for the encounter. Exalt reaches 2 allies at 6th level, 3 at 12th and 4 at 18th
  • Discord: a sharp jeer or discordant note. A target within 30ft makes a Will save or has Disadvantage on its next attack roll

Steady Voice

  • Effect: Allies within 30ft who can hear you have Advantage on saves against fear and charm. Always on.

Legend Lore (Charisma)

  • Effect: Recall relevant information about local notables, legendary items, noteworthy places, or obscure historical events.
  • May impart understanding of local or secret languages — Thieves' Cant, Druidic, Ranger signs
  • Does not reveal a magic item's powers but may hint at its history or function

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast arcane spells per the Spells Per Day table, beginning at 1st level.
  • You know a fixed set of spells, as a Sorcerer does: cantrips equal to the 0 column, and for each spell level one more spell than your slots of that level.
  • Cast any spell you know from an open slot of its level; during downtime you may swap one known spell for another of the same level.

3rd Level

Performance: Rally

  • Effect: A new Performance option: all creatures within earshot re-save against any fear or morale effect currently affecting them, even if they previously failed.
  • Those who succeed do not suffer from that fear source for the rest of the encounter
  • Extreme circumstances — Bard's death, army collapse, deity manifestation — may allow the GM to call for a new save to maintain the rally

4th Level

Fascinate (Charisma)

  • Effect: Place up to 2 creatures into a trance. Targets must be able to see and hear the Bard and must not be in immediate combat.
  • Will save to resist
  • A fascinated target sits quietly and listens — treated as prone and Incapacitated until the effect ends
  • Usable 3 times per day. Lasts until the scene ends or something breaks it
  • Any obvious threat, including an attack on the target or its allies, automatically breaks the effect
  • Targets scale: 2 creatures (4th), 4 (6th), 10 (12th)

5th Level

  • Fascinate — Charm Person: may attempt a Charm Person effect on a currently fascinated creature (Will save to resist)

Performance: Exhort Greatness

  • Effect: A new Performance option, costing 2 uses: inspire one creature with greatness. For the encounter it has Advantage on its first attack roll each round, and it gains temporary HP equal to two rolls of its Hit Die.
  • Add their Constitution modifier to each roll
  • The creature must hear the Bard and stay within 30ft
  • For every 2 levels beyond 9th, one additional creature can be inspired with the same use

6th Level

  • Fascinate targets increase to 4 creatures
  • Exalt reaches 2 allies

7th Level

Extra Attack

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).

8th Level

  • Fascinate — Suggestion: may implant a Suggestion in a currently fascinated creature (Will save to resist)

10th Level

Performance: Words of Power

  • Effect: A new Performance option, costing 2 uses: send forth a word of power at one creature. It makes a Will save or is deafened until the end of its next turn.

12th Level

  • Fascinate targets increase to 10 creatures
  • Exalt reaches 3 allies
  • Fascinate — Antipathy/Sympathy: may attempt an Antipathy/Sympathy effect on a currently fascinated creature (Will save to resist)

13th Level

Sway Crowd

  • Effect: Spend one use of Fascinate while performing: all listeners must make a Will save or be held in rapture, unable to leave while the Bard performs, and remaining held for rounds equal to Bard's level after they stop.
  • Affects up to 20 Levels of targets — lowest Level first
  • Affects any humanoid regardless of language
  • Scales: 40 Levels at 16th, 80 Levels at 19th, 160 Levels at 22nd

15th Level

  • Charisma Bonus: permanent +1 Charisma

17th Level

Words of Power (Improved)

  • Effect: Words of Power now strikes harder, with an effect based on the target's Level:
  • Level 4 or lower: death
  • Level 5–7: paralysis, blindness, and deafness
  • Level 8–11: blindness and deafness
  • Level 12 or higher: deafness until the end of its next turn
  • Durations (Level 11 or lower): deafness 1d4 rounds, blindness 2d4 rounds, paralysis 1d10 rounds

18th Level

  • Fascinate — Mass Suggestion: may implant a Mass Suggestion in currently fascinated creatures (Will save to resist)
  • Exalt reaches 4 allies

20th Level

Quest

  • Effect: Once per week, as an action, lay a quest on one target (Will save to resist). Acts in all respects as a Geas spell.

22nd Level

Change Alignment

  • Effect: Spend at least 1 hour per day for one month in free conversation with a target NPC.
  • After one month, the target makes a Will save against your Class Save DC
  • On a failure, their Outlook shifts one step
  • The Bard must maintain contact (1 hour/week) or the target begins reverting over subsequent months

24th Level

Sanctuary of Song

  • Effect: Once per week, create a barrier while performing — a 40ft radius that functions as an anti-magic shell AND erodes illusions.
  • Illusions: Will save against your Class Save DC
  • Time to destroy illusions: rounds equal to original caster's level

Kits: Bardic Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Bard folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation. Your kit defines the tradition that shaped your voice and your craft.

Bard Spell List

Spells available to the Bard, by level. * = reversible spell. ‡ = needs a costed material component (see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue).

  • Full descriptions, saves and components are in Spellcasting in Arneyan.
  • Includes every Wizard-list spell of the Bard’s favoured schools (Enchantment, Illusion and Divination), up to the highest spell level the Bard can cast, plus the spells listed below.
